title: Budapesti Honved clinch U20 Championship title
description: Budapesti Honved U20 - NKA Pecs U20 79:69 Budapesti Honved clinched U20 Championship title. In the Final game they edged NKA Pecs U20 79:69. Honved started with a 20-19 run and added massive 30-14 surge in the second frame. NKA Pecs replied with two narrow wins in the second half to reduce the score to the final. Mate Reizinger (194-F-2004) led the way with 18 points and Dominik Karda (186-G-2005) posted 14. Mark Mezofi (195-F-2007) answered with 23 points in the losing effort.

title: 2022/23 U21 League Season Recap: Falco-Vulcano Energia KC Szombathely U20 are champions
NKA Pecs U20 win National Championship
description: NKA Pecs U20 have won National Championship beating Budapesti Honved SE U20 81-71 in the decisive game. Salamon Herger (206-C-2001) and Gergely Schmera (196-F-2004) stepped up with 17 points each. Balint Scherer (196-F/G-2001) netted 12, whilst Oliver Vaits (180-G-2001) brought 10. Peter Redei (190-2002) replied with 16 points in the losing effort and Akos Kopacsi (182-PG-2001) produced 15. Budapesti Honved SE U20 finished second, whilst Falco-Volvo Alpok Auto Szombathely U20 clinched third place.

title: Egis Kormend celebrate U20 title
description: Egis Kormend are U20 Hungarian champions. They beat Alba Fehervar 65-60 in the title game. Matyas Kiss (195-G-01) recorded 17 points to lead the champions. Kormend grabbed a 28-25 halftime lead. They sank 24 points in the third term to secure a 6-point lead at the final break. Alba held their opponents to just 13 points in the fourth quarter but came up short at the end. Mate Balogh (203-PF-01) tossed in 14 points in the win. Adam Balsay (194-SG-01) answered with 13 points for Alba Fehervar.
